categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of computer-related hardware including graphics cards, motherboards, power supplies, and AI servers with system integration. It also engages in software development for AI platforms and provides related services. The business includes wholesale and retail of electronic components and peripherals, as well as system design and repair services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced GPU technologies such as NVIDIA's Blackwell architecture for graphics cards and develops high-performance motherboards supporting latest AMD and Intel chipsets. Production involves outsourced manufacturing with strict quality control processes including SMT and DIP assembly lines. The company also develops proprietary AI server software platforms and integrates AI hardware solutions, emphasizing high power, thin form factor designs and remote control software capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include computer system integrators, gaming hardware manufacturers, and AI infrastructure providers. Major markets served are PC gaming enthusiasts, workstation and server users, and AI application developers. The company’s products are sold primarily through distributors and agents, targeting end-users in gaming, professional computing, and AI sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with significant sales in the Asia-Pacific region, especially China, as well as presence in Europe and Korea through marketing centers. It maintains offices in Indonesia, India, and Cambodia to support regional markets. The majority of revenue is generated from exports to Asia-Pacific markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions primarily as a midstream manufacturer and developer of computer hardware components, relying on upstream suppliers for chips and electronic parts. It outsources production to contract manufacturers and focuses on design, R&D, and product integration. Downstream, it sells through distributors and agents to system integrators and end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-performance gaming motherboards and graphics cards aligned with latest NVIDIA and AMD chipsets, expanding AI server and system integration capabilities, and enhancing software tools for remote management. The company invests in R&D to shorten development cycles and maximize technology application across projects. It also focuses on sustainable operations and strengthening supply chain partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of graphics cards, motherboards, power supplies, and AI server systems. The company sells products via distributors and agents, with no direct consumer brand. Additional income comes from software platform licensing and system integration services related to AI solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the highly competitive PC hardware and AI server markets, with major competitors including NVIDIA, AMD, and other motherboard and graphics card manufacturers. It positions itself as a specialized OEM/ODM supplier with strong R&D capabilities and strategic partnerships, particularly in the Chinese market through collaboration with Colorful Technology.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.04 billion, a 9.27% decrease from the prior year, with net profit attributable to the parent company of NT$101 million. Despite a recent decline in revenue and profit, the company maintains a stable financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio around 31%. R&D investment accounts for about 5% of revenue, supporting future growth initiatives.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance, cutting-edge hardware solutions tailored for gaming and AI applications, leveraging the latest GPU architectures and chipset technologies. Its value lies in integrating advanced hardware with proprietary software platforms for AI servers, offering customers enhanced performance, stability, and remote management capabilities. Strong supply chain partnerships and a focus on sustainable, quality-driven manufacturing further differentiate its offerings.
